label: Modal root wiring
summary:
Modal root wiring (owner direction 2026-11-07). Finding: the necessary-being route's NecessaryAt m.ontic w n is literally the Kripke box of TruthCore.Modal.Kripke over m.ontic.frame applied to the existence atom (necessaryAt_iff_boxExistsAt, Iff.rfl); the route needs no frame condition, so its necessity is in logic K, and no bridge identifies it with modal necessity. Certified a sense fork over 'necessary' (TruthCore.Causality.NecessarySenseFork): nine senses (box-existence K possibilist, actualist K, de dicto K, KT, S4, KTB, S5, tertia via 'cannot not-be' with diamond possibility, per se) with NecessaryIn by cases; per-branch theorems; joint fork theorem with OPEN coverage (STMT-NECESSARY-SENSES-EXHAUSTIVE), exclusivity as a choice of one reading (STMT-NECESSARY-SENSE-UNIQUE) and side conditions (STMT-NECESSARY-INTENDED-SENSE-SUPPORTED); root route NECESSARY-CLASSICAL-GOD-CASE-SENSE-FORK with the sense as parameter; nine strengthens registrations (S5->S4->T->actualist K->K->de dicto/tertia; S5->KTB->T; per se->tertia), using axiomT_valid, s5_implies_s4, s5_implies_ktb; controls with frame laws (axioms T, 4, B, Euclidean) and separations (T vs S4, actualist vs possibilist, de dicto vs de re, per se vs tertia) and one nonvacuity model. By-product (not modal): the two conjuncts of the met common-ground commitment STMT-CAUSAL-POWER-AND-ACTIVITY-REQUIRE-CONCRETENESS registered as strengthens to STMT-CAUSERS-REQUIRE-CONCRETENESS-AT and STMT-CAUSAL-POWER-REQUIRES-CONCRETENESS-AT, which establishes both and lowers NECESSARY-CLASSICAL-GOD-CASE from 60 to 59 (ADOPTED-POTENCY 59 to 58). Rejected leads: (a) lowering the cheapest route (cost 30) with modal results: every leaf there is sourced/supported and proved from open premises, so only establishment lowers cost; modal results are premise-free certificates over specific frames while root vocabulary is parametric, so any modal derivation of a root leaf needs an open bridge (relocation, no cost drop). (b) Deriving STMT-GOD-IS-ETERNAL or STMT-GOD-IS-IMMUTABLE from modal necessity: worlds are complete histories; box-existence across histories gives neither everlastingness nor changelessness (#469), so no modal theorem discharges them. (c) Defining MerelyPossible modally to make STMT-MERELY-POSSIBLE-DOES-NOT-EXIST-AT analytic: it closes one leaf only by strengthening STMT-LACKING-ESSE-IS-MERELY-POSSIBLE to claim possibility of every non-actual candidate (false for impossibilia); not pursued. (d) Modal rival defence (#462 modal collapse, necessitism, #535 fixed history, #437 symmetry): no recorded alternative_to of any root-route premise is modal; recording a modal rival and refuting it with a premise-free model would defend nothing honestly (a refutation needs the rival's negation from established premises, and only eight floor items are established). No per-sense refutes relation applies: each failing branch fails by countermodel (non-entailment), not by refutation of a rival statement. Existence-consumer follow-up (2026-11-08): boxKToActualistK reverses the existing actualist-to-box edge without any extra premise: RootFacts already includes ActualRoot and hence ExistsAt of the same witness. Bare box-existence alone still fails to imply actuality in the explicit Unit candidate/empty existence/no-edge fixture; positive root nonvacuity reuses the existing fixture. Rejected: add reflexivity or a universal domain-to-actuality bridge to this consumer; both are unnecessary strengthenings. DISAMB-EXISTS still has legacy duplicated Box declarations, so this consumer result does not finish the global existential taxonomy, coverage/exclusivity, or its typed senses. No passage from arbitrary ExistsAt to act-in-esse is inferred. See specs/existence-sense-route.toml. PR1254 review repair: the initial bridge incorrectly targeted NECESSARY_11 (Frame). Corrected to append NECESSARY_12 with sense label NECESSARY_12 and stipulative definition 5bd704bb-4915-4657-9801-022247312147, reusing the already distinct, transparent NecessaryRootActualistK declaration. Source NECESSARY_2 is NecessaryAt, not a frame. Removed incidental Frame definition links from the two consumed K root nodes and synchronized their originating spec. Existing labels and identities remain unchanged. The scoped batch studies these two concrete readings; no unnamed alternative is a blocker.

Rotating-bearer comparison (2026-11-09): reused exact Control.swapOntic and Solution.certificate, rather than minting another de-dicto/de-re countermodel. Proposed general classification over the existing nine-constructor Sense enum in specs/rotating-bearer-sense-comparison.toml: under RotatingExistence, NecessaryIn s x iff s=deDictoK, retaining one profile, accessibility, rigid candidate identity and existence meaning throughout. Explicit ExcludedMiddle is retained for the general converse from cannot-not-be to box-existence; no hidden classical axiom. perSe additionally denies a distinct cause of necessity but already includes cannot-not-be; that conjunct suffices for exclusion. RootClassification keeps RootFacts as an independent existential obligation and derives no divine identity, attributes, immutability or eternity from population. Existing UnderivedRootRoute.rotating has ExistsAt=True everywhere with changing grounding edges, so rotatingSupport is not this rival. Existing modal witness-scope/degree controls concern varying causal possibility witnesses/intensities, not exchange of existential and box quantifiers. Rejected: infer all rivals false from one model; infer de-dicto population supplies a God witness; infer stronger S5 accessibility alone supplies a fixed existent. Controls reuse populated Bool swap on universal access (S5), plus the fixed unit model omitting no-common-bearer. Essence-based Scott/Goedel/filtered necessity remains outside enum as a named gap: NECESSARY_7 is FilteredNecessaryExistence, NECESSARY_8 is Box. OPEN applicability burdens: rigid transworld identity, history/world interpretation, existence valuation and coverage/exclusivity of intended readings. Conditional comparison is not independent defense of these meanings and closes no root premise. Connection target: STMT-NECESSARY-ROOT-ON-INTENDED-READING on NECESSARY-CLASSICAL-GOD-CASE-SENSE-FORK. Missing bridge to truth: route inputs and independent RootFacts, not population. Verification is reported by delivered-head PR checks; this attempt does not assert proof success from seeded artifacts. Exact prior witness-scope reuse boundary: TruthCore.Case.Catholicism.StageOne.NecessaryIndividual.Quantifiers defines DeRe/DeDicto, deRe_to_deDicto and AlternatingCountermodel; its alternatingExists x w is x=w, while swapOntic uses w=x. Results.Case.Catholicism.StageOne.NecessaryIndividual.Alternating.checks already verifies actual population, individual contingency, de-dicto concrete population, absence of a de-re bearer and failure of joint absence in that same universal Bool frame. This comparison deliberately reuses the fork-local certificate rather than duplicating that witness or claiming its existence as new. New scope is the arbitrary-profile nine-sense classification and separate RootFacts equivalence. Pages comparison follow-up after feature1292: nine explicit rows in specs/rotating-bearer-sense-comparison.toml. Eight full-root exclusions are mapped to rootClassification with explicit internal EM and fixed profile/identity/domain/accessibility. KT/S4/KTB/S5 share DEF-KANT-MODAL-NECESSITY only for their fixed-bearer clause, with frame laws specified in scope; no distinct frame-class necessity definitions or equivalences are invented. actualistK uses the existing root-constrained definition; tertiaVia/perSe retain the same-frame diamond interpretation. The deDictoK full-root row is unresolved: controls witnesses populated swap compatibility for its necessity clause only, not RootFacts. DEF-QML-KB-NECESSITY supplies only the Box operator, not a de-dicto root definition or inherited KB framework. Rival ID is the existing Controls statement, explicitly scoped to its RotatingExistence conjunct, not asserted to be a standalone universal rival proposition. Missing metadata: no standalone statement for that rival and no distinct de-dicto root sense definition; no new claims/proofs/definitions are added to conceal those gaps. Next discriminating step, if selected: an independent RootFacts interpretation on the SAME rotating profile. Coverage/exclusivity and outside-enum essence senses remain OPEN. Annotations do not alter premise closure. Proof evidence from db8fec4 is reused because owned Lean and Comparator inputs are unchanged.

NECESSARY_5 declaration investigation (2026-11-09): inspected context/dossier/related for the coverage node, Modal.Kripke Formula/neg/Holds/Valid, Verificationism.Language/Entails/Satisfiable, TruthPilot.Sentence and Mathlib first-order consumers ReferenceAnchor/PhysicalSpecification. TruthPilot's two test sentences do not constitute a general formula language; Verificationism.Language admits arbitrary world restrictions and does not itself enforce all logical interpretations. Reused the fork's Unit profile rather than inventing a new ontic model. LogicalNecessityContrast supplies a bounded explicit classical frame-validity profile with full valuation/world domain, semantic denial-unsatisfiability equivalence, validity-to-truth-and-box, arbitrary inhabited-frame atomic invalidity, positive identity nonvacuity and the same-formula actual/box versus validity control. These are declaration helpers, not registered consequences or an original NECESSARY_5 binding. No allowance removed; original identity and prose definition retained. Rejected: double negation of an arbitrary Lean Prop, opaque necessary flags, using truth at one world, claiming fixed-frame validity is all-frame K validity, restricting valuations to one existence model, and treating nonempty first-order domains as existence of God. No source acquisition required. Root connection is the omitted logical reading of the necessary-being fork, not a new isolated logic library. Next slice: choose and encode explicit sibling logic profiles plus an existence-formula translation, compare full logical validity with stated-theory entailment under a joint-model premise, then supply an explicit bridge before extending the root enum. The generic original cannot be completed merely by advertising this bounded profile as all logical necessity.

Logical profile follow-up (2026-11-09): specs/logical-necessity-profiles.toml compares declaration-backed analyst candidate siblings NECESSARY_13 (all valuations/worlds of one frame), NECESSARY_14 (all frames over small world types, same modal Formula), and NECESSARY_15 (local stated-theory consequence on that frame). Exact single-premise weakenings K -> selected frame -> theory preserve the same formula. Strict controls: T holds on the universal Unit frame but fails K on a dead Unit frame; the singleton atom theory entails an invalid atom; actual true-and-box fails empty-theory consequence. Consistent theory entailment also fails truth in a selected valuation that does not satisfy it. Inconsistent falsum theory entails everything and has no joint model. JointModel blocks falsum consequence. The explicit TheoryOnCone guard admits the stated theory at the actual point and each accessible successor, enabling truth-and-box with no reflexivity. The root bridge concludes existing STMT-NECESSARY-ROOT-BOX-K under that theory entailment, cone admission, forall-world same-formula/same-bearer existence dictionary and independently supplied RootFacts. The actual cone conjunct ensures theory nonvacuity; only its successor conjunct is consumed for box-existence, so this is a selected consistent profile rather than a claim of premise minimality. Positive Unit fixture jointly satisfies all inputs. Dictionary omission control retains actual root/divine facts while the bearer is absent at its accessible successor and a valid identity formula remains true. RootFacts omission control retains admitted atom theory and correct existence dictionary but sets IsGod=False. These are non-entailment witnesses, not universal refutations or metaphysical possibility claims. Original NECESSARY_5 remains unbound: no allowance removed, no original identity or generic contradictory-denial definition weakened. No first-order completeness, all-logics profile, existence of a particular being from a nonempty domain, divine attributes from validity, intended-reading coverage/exclusivity, or root premise discharge is claimed. Rejected: infer box from local theory admission alone; infer theory nonvacuity from the entailment flag; infer real existence from an arbitrary valid formula without dictionary. OPEN semantic obligations remain same-bearer transworld identity, route ExistsAt applicability, independent RootFacts and intended profile choice. Exact next discriminating cell: can a stated theory with independent support justify this bearer existence formula on the same cone, rather than simply assuming that formula as a theory member? The singleton theory is only a nonvacuity/control example, not that defense. Shared service was unconfigured, so CLI fallback used. Inventory: corpus.py orphans absent in this checkout; thickness --queue exposes unused-definition results and identifies the logical fork frontier. Verification evidence belongs to delivered-head PR checks; this attempt confers no closure. Sense-binding boundary: explicit term_senses on kToFrame and frameToTheory passes. NECESSARY_15 remains explicitly selected on both generic guard bridges, but their sense binding is blocked by legacy NECESSARY_11 pointing at TruthCore.Modal.Frame (sense NECESSARY_11 in DISAMB-NECESSARY; definition f8948e28-b13a-5244-95f1-41a05cd4fff2). Exact other-sense-mentioned collisions: theoryToTrueAndBox at hc: TheoryOnCone and result: TrueAndBox; theoryToRoot at hc: TheoryOnCone and hd: ExistenceDictionary. These are frame carrier occurrences, not a passage between necessity meanings; no honest premise/conclusion bridge to that frame sense exists. The selected theory declaration is TheoryRelativeEntailment (sense NECESSARY_15 in DISAMB-NECESSARY). No new allowlist entry, metadata omission, or change to the legacy Frame sense is delivered. At the initial checked head five result bindings passed and the two generic bridge sense bindings were blocked. Lean compilation was not reported as completion of that gate. Independent local gates completed on unchanged owned Lean inputs: all seven exact Challenge/Solution Comparator checks and their solution NanoDa checks passed with zero permitted axioms; module-scoped NanoDa checked 298 declarations with no typechecker errors. Warm full lake build, source-evidence manifests, corpus check, bundle audit, module conversion, attribution self-check and exploration map pass. At that initial head two selected-sense binding failures blocked publication. Required delivered-head CI remains required for the published revision. The computed frontier diagnostic adds one conditional support alternative and four bare inputs; its cheapest expanded cost 28 to 16 reflects packaging independent full RootFacts as an open premise, not discharging the removed expanded-route leaves. Claim/type self-sweep accepts only the stated conditionals and finite semantic non-entailments; no source claims were added. Metadata repair (same slice, 2026-11-09): registered genuine premise bridges, retaining both explicit NECESSARY_15 selections. TheoryOnCone is equivalent to every selected theory formula being true at w and under raw Box over the same accessible cone; with same-theory entailment it licenses NECESSARY_8 selected-formula boxing. ExistenceDictionary pointwise relates this same formula to ExistsAt of one fixed bearer, transferring NECESSARY_8 boxing to NECESSARY_2 de re box-existence. theoryToTrueAndBox now records cone admission 15-to-8 as a premise bridge and TrueAndBox 15-to-8 as a derived conclusion bridge; theoryToRoot records cone 15-to-8 and dictionary 8-to-2 premise bridges, retaining its existing derived root conclusion 15-to-2. DEF-QML-KB-NECESSITY links the TrueAndBox box clause only to its raw Box operator interpretation (Box F (fun v => Holds F V v phi) w); no KB frame/domain/comprehension or classical-host assumptions are inherited. The pointwise and cone obligations are stated in the argument and statement prose. No bridge to Frame/NECESSARY_11 is claimed; the legacy carrier misclassification and its initial diagnostic remain as recorded, with no checker or allowance change. These conversions are meaningful independently of the detector exemption for explicit bridge premises. Focused recheck of the two affected bindings passes 2 bound, 0 mismatch; together with unchanged five-result evidence all seven bindings are checked. Seven Comparator and per-solution NanoDa checks, scoped module NanoDa and unchanged build evidence are reused. Final claim/type self-sweep accepts precisely these contextual conversions, with independent RootFacts still open and no premise discharge. The apparently lower expanded root-route cost is caused by packaging full RootFacts as an independent open bundle, not by establishing divinity, attributes or any removed expanded leaf.
